schedule_exceptions_scope_target.name: schedule_exceptions_scope_target
schedule_exceptions_scope_target.value: ("schedule_exceptions"."scope" = 'location' AND "schedule_exceptions"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_exceptions"."staff_id" IS NULL) OR ("schedule_exceptions"."scope" = 'staff' AND "schedule_exceptions"."staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_exceptions"."location_id" IS NULL)

bookings_pending_expiry_valid.name: bookings_pending_expiry_valid
bookings_pending_expiry_valid.value: ("bookings"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "bookings"."pending_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("bookings"."status" <> 'PENDING' AND "bookings"."pending_expires_at" IS NULL)

tenant_applications_review_state_valid.name: tenant_applications_review_state_valid
tenant_applications_review_state_valid.value: ("tenant_applications"."status" = 'pending' AND "tenant_applications"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "tenant_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "tenant_applications"."tenant_id" IS NULL) OR ("tenant_applications"."status" = 'approved' AND "tenant_applications"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_applications"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tenant_applications"."status" = 'rejected' AND "tenant_applications"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_applications"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_applications"."tenant_id" IS NULL)

billing_orders_paid_state_valid.name: billing_orders_paid_state_valid
billing_orders_paid_state_valid.value: ("billing_orders"."status" = 'paid' AND "billing_orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("billing_orders"."status" <> 'paid' AND "billing_orders"."paid_at" IS NULL)

payment_attempts_completion_state_valid.name: payment_attempts_completion_state_valid
payment_attempts_completion_state_valid.value: ("payment_attempts"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'expired', 'cancelled') AND "payment_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_attempts"."status" IN ('initializing', 'pending') AND "payment_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL)

payment_reconciliations_completion_state.name: payment_reconciliations_completion_state_valid
payment_reconciliations_completion_state.value: ("payment_reconciliations"."outcome" = 'started' AND "payment_reconciliations"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("payment_reconciliations"."outcome" <> 'started' AND "payment_reconciliations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_webhook_events_processing_state_.name: payment_webhook_events_processing_state_valid
payment_webhook_events_processing_state_.value: ("payment_webhook_events"."status" = 'processed' AND "payment_webhook_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_webhook_events"."status" <> 'processed' AND "payment_webhook_events"."processed_at" IS NULL)
